A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Sanyassan''' with long [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] once assaulted the crew of a [[StarSpeeder 3000]] transport of the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency. Along with a fellow criminal of the same [[Species/Legends|species]], he entered a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], where the Star Tours spacecraft had landed. While his colleague threatened the crewmen, the long-haired Sanyassan kept a lookout, armed with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="EndorModdell" />
